aboutPage.seoDescription: Rosa Beauty Facial Care formulates and manufactures natural rose-based facial care in Côte d'Ivoire. Discover our story, our commitments and our workshops.
aboutPage.heroDescBefore: Rosabeauty Facial Care was born from a personal story, a passion for beauty and a desire to help women care for their skin with gentleness and confidence. The
aboutPage.heroDescStrong: first Ivorian brand dedicated to the rose
aboutPage.heroDescAfter: , to reveal your skin's natural radiance.
aboutPage.visionQuote: “Your body is your best accessory — take care of it.”
aboutPage.founderText1: Like many women, I struggled with skin problems that affected my self-confidence. On my journey to healthy, radiant skin I discovered the exceptional benefits of the rose. Won over by its soothing, hydrating and brightening properties, it quickly became an essential part of my beauty routine.
aboutPage.founderText2: The results sparked a genuine passion in me and a desire to share this natural treasure with other women. That is how Rosabeauty Facial Care was born.
aboutPage.roseDesc: At the heart of Rosa Beauty Facial Care is the Damask rose — a precious ingredient recognised for centuries for its exceptional virtues on the skin. It is the common thread across our whole range.
aboutPage.roseImgAlt: Damask rose — Rosa Beauty Facial Care
aboutPage.roseBenefit1Desc: Restores the hydrolipidic film and retains water in the deeper layers.
aboutPage.roseBenefit2Desc: Calms irritation, reduces redness and strengthens skin tolerance.
aboutPage.roseBenefit3Desc: Evens out the complexion, reveals natural radiance and gives luminous skin every day.
aboutPage.missionText1Before: At Rosabeauty Facial Care, our mission is not to change the colour of your skin, but to help it be
aboutPage.missionText1After: . We believe every woman deserves to feel beautiful in her skin and to care for herself with products suited to her needs.
aboutPage.missionText2: Over the years, Rosabeauty Facial Care has grown thanks to the trust of thousands of customers. Every product is designed with love, rigour and respect for the skin, to offer a unique care experience — created for African skin, its radiance and its specific needs.
aboutPage.missionPoint2: No parabens, sulfates or artificial colourants
aboutPage.processDesc: Every manufacturing step is designed to preserve the benefits of natural ingredients.
aboutPage.step1Desc: Our Damask roses are picked by hand, flower by flower, in the rose gardens of our partner growers.
aboutPage.step2Desc: Our formulas are developed with cosmetics experts to guarantee efficacy and skin tolerance.
aboutPage.step3Desc: Every batch is rigorously tested before distribution to guarantee consistent quality and optimal safety.
aboutPage.step4Desc: Your products arrive in careful packaging, straight to your door, anywhere in Côte d'Ivoire.
aboutPage.value1Desc: Formulas designed to preserve the benefits of natural actives, with no compromise on efficacy.
aboutPage.value2Desc: Every product is formulated to deliver visible results, suited to all skin types.
aboutPage.value3Desc: Quality beauty should not be reserved for a few. Rosa Beauty Facial Care is for everyone.
aboutPage.value4Desc: We are committed to responsible production that respects people and the environment.
aboutPage.galleryAlt2: Pickers in the rose garden, at the foot of the Atlas
aboutPage.galleryAlt3: Roses harvested by hand, flower by flower
aboutPage.galleryAlt4: Damask roses in bloom in the rose garden
aboutPage.galleryAlt5: The rose garden facing the Atlas mountains
aboutPage.ctaDesc: . More than a cosmetics brand, Rosabeauty Facial Care is an invitation to care for yourself, to love yourself more and to reveal your natural beauty.
aboutPage.ctaAttribution: — Maïmouna Diabagate, founder of Rosa Beauty Facial Care
